planned_step_size_check.scope: Successive central gm/gds secants at fixed mesh; qualifying mesh error for smaller stencils remains a separate check.

comparison_rule: absolute difference <= absolute floor + relative tolerance * max(abs(coarse), abs(fine))
secants: Centered drain-current differences: three gm estimates at fixed Vds, three gds estimates at fixed Vgs; each uses endpoints separated by 0.10 V.
required_evidence: matching device, physics, runtime and experiment
complete predeclared training and holdout split
verified artifact hashes and dataset fingerprint
acceptance_scope: Mesh agreement at nine sampled biases and for six finite-span secants only.
